title: Warning call after a Howard Stern producer's call

tellings.quote: on the other end of the line said, "Drop the story. Don't go on the Sahara Stern and stop talking about it."

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that soon after a producer from Howard Stern's radio show called him, he got another call warning him off. He tells Michels the voice on the line said to drop the story, stay off Stern's show and stop talking about it. If that is true, someone was watching him closely enough to know who had called him.
